bibl.title: Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt.
bibl.seg: Mattias Brand & Eline Scheerlinck (edd.), Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt.
London - New York, Routledge, 2023, xii-302 pp., figg. ISBN 978-1-032-26349-6 (hbk) / 978-1-032-26350-2 (pbk).
bibl.note: 11 contributions. The volume draws its origins from the 2017 conference "Late Antique Religion in Practice: Papyri and the Dynamics of Religious Identification" of the Leiden University Papyrological Institute. - Pp. viii: M.Br. & E.S., Preface; - 1-26: M.B., Introduction. Theorizing Religious Identification in Late Antique Papyri: Applying Religious Labels; - A Situational Approach to Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri; - Demarcations and Limitations; - 278-295: M.B., Concluding Remarks: "The Artificers of Facts": Where Markers Fail; - Groupism; - Situations; - Multiple Identities and Crossing Group Boundaries; - Opportunities. - Part I. Problematizing Religious "Identity" and the Identification of Religious Groups. - Part II. Reconstructing Situational Religious Identifications. - Part III. Performance and Audience. - Index.
